semiconductor_relevance: High — inTEST EMS Corporation provides essential testing equipment and solutions for semiconductor manufacturers, focusing on integrated circuits and wafer products.
summary: inTEST EMS Corporation designs, manufactures, and markets testing products used by semiconductor manufacturers to ensure the quality and reliability of their integrated circuits and wafer products. Their offerings include test head manipulators, docking hardware, and test interfaces that facilitate automated testing and device handling with precision and safety.
